pull_request.body:
Fixes the test-infrastructure defect **F01 / P2** from [independent review #2](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/pull/2): Vite preview returns HTML with HTTP 200 for a missing bundled stylesheet, so the old smoke incorrectly passed an unstyled app.

The production smoke now discovers local stylesheet links, checks actual browser response status/CSS MIME and parsed enabled sheets, then checks stable applied styles (body reset, root overflow, header flex layout). The real application, offline network boundary, model/comparison interactions, local-resource failures and fatal-JavaScript checks remain active. No hashed build filename or external resource is required.

A disposable-build control runner executes the same smoke and is now required in CI. Intact builds pass before and after controls. Missing CSS/HTML fallback, removed links, empty CSS, unrelated nonempty CSS and injected fatal JavaScript must fail specifically at the intended assertion; unrelated setup failures do not satisfy a control.

## Source binding and scope

- Base: `main` at `7b813beeebfa3ded90aacda3d69dab76a5ea991d`, tree `85c621486eafb7eb2bdf95189fc89c059ba7dc83`.
- Head: `fix/pr01-css-smoke-validation` at `accfb1e895f16b4aec32db5dd5025a1bf2782898`.
- Head tree: `027d88998218c98966f95db7bbe1362e6703009c`; sole parent is the verified base.
- Remote branch was fetched and its tree matched the locally staged tree exactly.
- Preflight confirmed only evidence PR #2 was open and no competing fix branch existed.
- No changes to `src/`, product HTML, dependencies/lockfile, Playwright configuration, or lint exceptions. PR #1/#2 branches and historical evidence are untouched.
- [Implementation report and reproducible evidence](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/accfb1e895f16b4aec32db5dd5025a1bf2782898/docs/verification/pr01-f01-css-smoke/REPORT.md); [command exits](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/accfb1e895f16b4aec32db5dd5025a1bf2782898/docs/verification/pr01-f01-css-smoke/logs/checks.json); [verified file bindings](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/accfb1e895f16b4aec32db5dd5025a1bf2782898/docs/verification/pr01-f01-css-smoke/logs/source-bindings.json).

## Reproduction and local results

The exact original review probes were executed against the original reviewed product: missing CSS produced HTTP 200 `text/html`, zero rules, default 8px body margin and no page errors; the unchanged original smoke exited **0 / one passed**. The original negative harness exited 1 because this coverage expectation was unmet. This is F01 reproduction, not a failed ordinary CI run.

On the corrected files, clean `npm ci --cache /tmp/vision-edge-npm-cache`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npm test` (3 files / 8 tests), `npm run build`, normal Chromium `npm run test:e2e`, `npm run test:e2e:controls`, and `git diff --check` all exited **0**. Browser commands used `PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH=/usr/bin/chromium`.

Control child exits: intact **0**, missing CSS/HTML fallback **1** (MIME), absent link **1** (link count), empty CSS **1** (parsed rules), unrelated CSS **1** (applied style), fatal JavaScript **1** (existing pageErrors assertion), intact after controls **0**. The control runner exits **0** when these expected results occur.

Linux x86_64, Node **24.19.0**, npm **11.9.0**, Playwright **1.64.1**, local system Chromium **154.0.8037.57**. Local matched-browser download exited 1 with HTTP 403 `Domain forbidden`; these local results are not matched-browser claims. A fresh detached checkout of exact published HEAD `accfb1e895f16b4aec32db5dd5025a1bf2782898`, tree `027d88998218c98966f95db7bbe1362e6703009c`, reran the full clean installation/static/unit/build/smoke/control sequence: **all commands exited 0**, eight unit/component tests passed, all seven control outcomes matched, and final `git status --porcelain` was empty. Every verified file blob and every built-file SHA-256 matched the committed evidence manifest. The exact-head run installed dependencies before querying the local Playwright version.

## Hosted CI

[CI run 40050196050](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/actions/runs/40050196050), [verify job 120740948261](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/actions/runs/40050196050/job/120740948261): **completed / success**, terminal run updated **2026-10-24 01:33:03 UTC**, exact HEAD `accfb1e895f16b4aec32db5dd5025a1bf2782898`. The exact-commit check-run API also reports `verify` completed/success. All steps succeeded, including clean locked installation, typecheck, ESLint, 3 files / 8 unit/component tests, production build, matched Chromium install, normal smoke, **Stylesheet smoke controls**, artifact upload and cleanup.

Downloaded job logs confirm checkout of that exact SHA, Node **24.19.0**, npm **11.17.0**, matched Chromium / headless shell **v1248 (Chrome 156.0.8078.4)**, one ordinary smoke pass, both intact control passes and the five intended negative child failures. The control runner and hosted job exited successfully; expected negative child exits 1 are not failed CI. No local system-browser override was used in hosted CI.

## Independent handoff and limits

Keep Draft. A separate non-Author reviewer must verify this exact head/tree and base ancestry, inspect the scoped diff, rerun clean checks/controls, independently apply the original missing-href mutation to the corrected build/smoke and confirm CSS-specific failure plus healthy offline success, and confirm terminal hosted CI includes the controls on this exact head. The original review harness archives the frozen old source; applying its mutation to corrected source is the relevant re-review. This Author has not launched or self-declared independent acceptance.

Windows/macOS, real camera/model/GPU inference, tracking/geometry/FPS, audible/full TTS, broad accessibility and deployment equivalence remain unverified. F02–F05 stay in their recorded scope. No main merge, auto-merge, deployment, release, branch-protection changes or PR-02/03 implementation is authorized here.

@@ -0,0 +1,143 @@
+# PR-01 F01 stylesheet smoke correction
+
+Author implementation evidence, 2026-10-24 UTC. This proposes repair of **F01 / P2**
+from [independent review PR #2](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/pull/2).
+It is not independent acceptance; a separate non-Author re-review remains required.
+
+## Source and scope
+
+Preflight fetched current main and both relevant remote branches, and inspected
+the complete open-PR/branch collections. Main was
+`7b813beeebfa3ded90aacda3d69dab76a5ea991d`, tree
+`85c621486eafb7eb2bdf95189fc89c059ba7dc83`, identical to reviewed product
+`f20474be156522ee6141cde9c2b3a958db8d2457`. Only evidence PR #2 was open;
+there was no duplicate fix or competing fix branch. The new branch
+`fix/pr01-css-smoke-validation` starts from that main. No `AGENTS.md` or checkout
+`.agents/skills` was present, and `/workspace/.agents` was empty.
+
+Read the report, structured finding register, index, and exact negative/CSS
+observation probes at review commit `67e0c15e652d88c773a82b06f615b2befa27a695`,
+tree `328519ed7bcba68ca303173f5e7bb608c4371365`. Review evidence was extracted
+under `/tmp` for execution; its branch and historical evidence are untouched.
+
+Changed infrastructure: production smoke, one disposable-control runner, its npm
+script/CI step, and README/evidence. `src/`, application entrypoint, dependencies,
+lockfile, camera, inference, models, tracking, TTS, UI and lint exceptions are
+unchanged. F02–F05 remain outside this repair. No review branch merge was used.
+
+## Independent reproduction of the original failure
+
+Built the clean current-main product tree before edits with `npm run build`
+(exit 0). Executed the exact original `css-observation.py` and
+`negative-controls.py` from PR #2 against that build, with system Chromium.
+The original probe's source archive is frozen to reviewed product SHA `f20474b`.
+
+`logs/before-css-observation.json` records intact CSS as HTTP 200 `text/css`,
+48 top-level rules, body margin `0px`, and body background `rgb(7, 11, 20)`.
+Changing only the generated local stylesheet href to `/assets/review-missing.css`
+returns HTTP 200 `text/html`, zero rules, margin `8px`, transparent background,
+and no page errors. `logs/before-missing-css.txt` records the **unchanged original
+smoke exiting 0 / one passed**, reproducing F01. The original negative-control
+harness consequently exits 1 because CSS loss should fail; that is the reproduced
+coverage defect, not a failed normal CI run. Its other injected controls produced
+their expected outcomes, including the existing fatal JavaScript/UI checks.
+
+Actual probe invocation, from `/workspace/vision-edge` after extracting the review
+tree to `/tmp/pr01-f01-before` and linking its locked `node_modules`:
+
+```sh
+npm run build
+# Give the extracted probe access to the frozen source object it archives.
+git init /tmp/pr01-f01-before
+git -C /tmp/pr01-f01-before fetch /workspace/vision-edge f20474be156522ee6141cde9c2b3a958db8d2457
+PR01_REVIEW_DIST=/workspace/vision-edge/dist python3 /tmp/pr01-f01-before/docs/verification/pr01-independent-review/probes/css-observation.py
+PR01_REVIEW_DIST=/workspace/vision-edge/dist python3 /tmp/pr01-f01-before/docs/verification/pr01-independent-review/probes/negative-controls.py
+```
+
+The original scripts set `PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH=/usr/bin/chromium`.
+A first extraction-only attempt to run the negative harness lacked Git metadata;
+initializing/fetching the frozen object corrected that setup failure. An early
+build started before installation completed also exited 127; the completed
+post-install baseline build and subsequent clean verification are the evidence.
+
+## Correction and deterministic controls
+
+The smoke discovers same-origin stylesheet links from the loaded production DOM,
+then checks their actual browser responses for status 200 and CSS MIME. It checks
+enabled CSSOM sheets with parsed rules, plus the real body's zero-margin reset,
+root overflow, and header flex layout. There are no hardcoded hashed filenames,
+pixel screenshots or external-resource dependencies. The original app execution,
+camera denial, blocked external loader observation, model/comparison interaction,
+local request failures and final uncaught-JavaScript assertions remain active.
+
+`scripts/smoke-css-controls.mjs` copies the real build, smoke and preview config
+to a temporary directory with the installed dependencies linked in. Every case
+runs the same smoke in a fresh Chromium/preview process. It never replaces the
+app or edits the original build. Negative cases must exit 1 with exactly one
+failed smoke and the intended assertion diagnostic; an unrelated browser/server
+failure cannot satisfy a control. The runner exits 0 only if all controls agree.
+
+| Build/control | Required child result | Diagnostic |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| Intact | 0 / one pass | All original UI, network, fatal-JS and new CSS checks |
+| Missing generated CSS URL | 1 / one failure | Required stylesheet MIME; actual Vite HTML fallback |
+| Removed local stylesheet link | 1 / one failure | Required local stylesheet links |
+| Empty CSS file, still CSS MIME | 1 / one failure | Required stylesheet parsed rules |
+| Nonempty unrelated valid CSS | 1 / one failure | Required stylesheet applied body reset |
+| Injected uncaught exception | 1 / one failure | F01 fatal JavaScript control at existing pageErrors check |
+| Intact after mutations | 0 / one pass | Build preservation and recovery |
+
+The unrelated-CSS case contains a valid custom-property rule, so MIME and nonzero
+rule count alone cannot pass it. CI now runs these controls after the normal smoke;
+expected child failures are assertions of sensitivity, not failed CI jobs.
+
+## Local verification and reproduction
+
+Linux x86_64, Node `v24.19.0`, npm `11.9.0`, Playwright `1.64.1`, system Chromium
+`154.0.8037.57`. Full output and exits are in `logs/checks.json` and numbered logs.
+`logs/source-bindings.json` records file blob IDs and unchanged product/lockfile
+bindings. The final publication HEAD/tree, exact-commit clean rerun and terminal
+hosted CI receipts are recorded in the Draft PR body to avoid a self-referential
+evidence commit. Hosted and local browser results must be read separately.
+
+Run on a fresh final-source checkout:
+
+```sh
+npm ci --cache /tmp/vision-edge-npm-cache
+npm run typecheck
+npm run lint
+npm test
+npm run build
+PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH=/usr/bin/chromium npm run test:e2e
+PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH=/usr/bin/chromium npm run test:e2e:controls
+git diff --check
+```
+
+All commands must exit 0; the control runner prints expected child exits 1 for
+the five fault cases and child exits 0 for two intact cases. It uses no resolver
+overrides and does not hide smoke failures. On hosted CI omit the system-browser
+override after `npx playwright install --with-deps chromium`.
+
+The local matched-browser install command below exited 1 with HTTP 403
+`Domain forbidden`; `logs/browser-install.txt` preserves the output. This is an
+environment download limit, not a successful matched-browser local run.
+
+```sh
+PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/tmp/vision-edge-browsers npm_config_cache=/tmp/vision-edge-npm-cache npx playwright install chromium
+```
+
+## Independent handoff and limits
+
+Re-review the exact final Draft PR HEAD/tree, verify current base/ancestry and
+scope, rerun clean checks and the automated controls, and independently confirm
+that the original missing-href probe now exits nonzero specifically for CSS while
+the intact real offline application still passes. Check terminal hosted CI belongs
+to that exact head and includes the new control step. Only that separate reviewer
+can decide whether F01's foundation condition is satisfied. The Author has not
+launched or declared independent acceptance.
+
+Unverified: Windows/macOS, real camera/stream lifecycle, GPU/model loading and
+inference, accuracy, geometry/tracking/FPS, audible/full TTS, broad accessibility,
+and deployment/source equivalence. The denied-camera shell does not certify those
+areas. No main merge, auto-merge, deployment, release, branch protection changes,
+PR #1/#2 updates or PR-02/03 implementation are part of this work.

+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
+import { cpSync, mkdtempSync, readFileSync, rmSync, symlinkSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
+import path from 'node:path';
+
+const root = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, '..');
+const probe = mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), 'vision-edge-css-controls-'));
+const html = readFileSync(path.join(root, 'dist/index.html'), 'utf8');
+const links = (html.match(/<link\b[^>]*\brel="stylesheet"[^>]*>/g) ?? [])
+  .filter(link => link.match(/href="([^"]+)"/)?.[1].startsWith('/'));
+assert(links.length > 0, 'Build must contain stylesheet links before running controls');
+
+// Each child executes the unchanged production smoke against a disposable build.
+// Require its specific assertion failure, so a server/browser crash cannot pass
+// a negative control. The intact build must pass first and again after mutations.
+const controls = [
+  { name: 'intact' },
+  { name: 'missing-css-html-fallback', failure: 'required stylesheet MIME' },
+  { name: 'absent-stylesheet-link', failure: 'required local stylesheet links' },
+  { name: 'empty-css', failure: 'required stylesheet parsed rules' },
+  { name: 'irrelevant-css', failure: 'required stylesheet applied body reset' },
+  { name: 'fatal-javascript', failure: 'F01 fatal JavaScript control' },
+  { name: 'intact-after-controls' },
+];
+
+try {
+  for (const file of ['package.json', 'playwright.config.ts', 'vite.config.ts', 'e2e']) {
+    cpSync(path.join(root, file), path.join(probe, file), { recursive: true });
+  }
+  symlinkSync(path.join(root, 'node_modules'), path.join(probe, 'node_modules'), 'junction');
+  for (const control of controls) {
+    const dist = path.join(probe, 'dist');
+    rmSync(dist, { recursive: true, force: true });
+    cpSync(path.join(root, 'dist'), dist, { recursive: true });
+    let mutated = html;
+    for (const [index, link] of links.entries()) {
+      if (control.name === 'missing-css-html-fallback') {
+        mutated = mutated.replace(link, link.replace(/href="[^"]+"/, `href="/assets/f01-missing-${index}.css"`));
+      } else if (control.name === 'absent-stylesheet-link') {
+        mutated = mutated.replace(link, '');
+      } else if (control.name === 'empty-css' || control.name === 'irrelevant-css') {
+        const href = link.match(/href="([^"]+)"/)?.[1];
+        assert(href?.startsWith('/'), 'Expected a local production stylesheet URL');
+        const file = path.resolve(dist, `.${href}`);
+        assert(file.startsWith(`${dist}${path.sep}`), 'Stylesheet must stay inside disposable dist');
+        writeFileSync(file, control.name === 'empty-css' ? '' : ':root { --f01-control: 1; }');
+      }
+    }
+    if (control.name === 'fatal-javascript') {
+      mutated = mutated.replace('</head>', '<script>setTimeout(() => { throw new Error("F01 fatal JavaScript control"); }, 0);</script></head>');
+    }
+    writeFileSync(path.join(dist, 'index.html'), mutated);
+    const result = spawnSync(process.execPath, [path.join(root, 'node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js'), 'test', '--reporter=json'], {
+      cwd: probe,
+      env: process.env,
+      encoding: 'utf8',
+      timeout: 90_000,
+    });
+    assert.ifError(result.error);
+    const report = JSON.parse(result.stdout);
+    const errors = report.suites.flatMap(suite => suite.specs.flatMap(spec =>
+      spec.tests.flatMap(test => test.results.flatMap(result => result.errors.map(error => error.message ?? '')))));
+    console.log(`${control.name}: exit=${result.status}; passed=${report.stats.expected}; failed=${report.stats.unexpected}`);
+    if (control.failure) {
+      assert.equal(result.status, 1, `${control.name}: expected smoke assertion failure`);
+      assert.equal(report.stats.unexpected, 1, `${control.name}: expected exactly one failed smoke`);
+      assert(errors.some(message => message.includes(control.failure)), `${control.name}: missing diagnostic ${control.failure}\n${errors.join('\n')}\n${result.stderr}`);
+      console.log(`  Expected failure confirmed: ${control.failure}`);
+    } else {
+      assert.equal(result.status, 0, `${control.name}: intact build must pass\n${errors.join('\n')}\n${result.stderr}`);
+      assert.equal(report.stats.expected, 1, `${control.name}: expected one passed smoke`);
+    }
+  }
+} finally {
+  rmSync(probe, { recursive: true, force: true });
+}
